svg.title: sosed.place — the app, screen by screen
svg.desc: Eleven screens of the chat app drawn from docs/chat_RU.md: the kit's geometry (2px frames, 4px hard offset shadows, radius 6, control height 36) with the landing's gold accent. Phones are 375 wide — the base screen from §10.

g.text: Eleven screens off docs/chat_RU.md — kit geometry, landing gold. Phone = 375, the base screen from §10.
Two fields, once. No email, no password.
Your identity lives in this browser only.
Another browser or device is someone else.
Clearing browser data erases it for good.
so it is asked before anything else
looking for a fourth for dominoes,
we are five, we have a speaker
no author, ever — a circle, not a pin
the like tells you nothing about who
2 · From a like to a chat
we are five, we have a speaker
looking for a fourth for dominoes,
a match needs both phrases alive
we are five, we have a speaker
DELETE THE CHAT AFTER, IF WE GO QUIET
The shorter of the two choices wins. You will
not be told which of you set it.
They have to press it too. If the phrase dies
first, this disappears — and there was no chat.
name and age are revealed here
so the embankment then? I am near the
you: I will bring the board
liked one more of your phrases
the tab counters are the whole inbox
1 you liked · “we are five, we have a speaker”
2 they liked · “a bench, a thermos, no plans”
you both liked this — chat is open
nine works. bench by the pier
THEY LIKED ONE MORE OF YOURS
history lives in this browser only
the server keeps none of it — §8.8
Both of you can move anything, anywhere.
No turns, no captures, no winner.
so a silent game keeps the chat alive
Still 38? We ask every few months.
WHO YOU SEE — YOUR BAND IS 21 AND UP
WHAT WE COUNT — NEVER WITH WHOM
A new identity loses every chat — yours and
your peers'. Nothing can be restored.
This reads as an insult aimed at a person.
nothing was written to the server
a few more and sending is paused — §8.8
the feed is checked before publishing,
bring the board, I have time
at the pier now, where are you
They got a push and may be opening the app.
nothing is queued on the server — §8.8
a refused message would say so instead,
and retrying it would be pointless
Nobody in this circle is talking right now,
or nobody matches your age filter.
the teenage band will be sparse at launch
anyone heading to the embankment tonight, around nine
looking for a fourth for dominoes, rules optional
we are five, we have a speaker and nowhere to go
you: I will bring the board
liked one more of your phrases
1 you liked · “we are five, we have a speaker”
2 they liked · “a bench, a thermos, no plans”
nine works. bench by the pier
THEY LIKED ONE MORE OF YOURS
columns collapse into vertical rails below 900 — the conversation becomes a full-screen overlay
Drawn off docs/chat_RU.md §§2–9 and §8. Geometry from the kit: 2px frames, 4px hard shadows, radius 6, control 36. Accent — the landing's gold.
Never drawn, because it never exists: an author under a feed phrase, a message on the server, an identifier of anyone you have not matched with.
